end.summary:
Harsh practised reading and plotting ordered pairs: (4,3) means 4 right and 3 up.
They practised that (3,2) and (2,3) are different points.
They practised identifying a point’s quadrant from coordinate signs; the quadrant answers need checking next time.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Harsh practised reading ordered pairs by moving along x first and y second, and also practised seeing why (3,2) and (2,3) are different locations. They gave an incorrect fourth-quadrant answer for a point below the x-axis and then an incorrect second-quadrant answer for a point left and above; this was not corrected later in the lesson. At home, ask them to sort points by signs: (+,+) first, (−,+) second, (−,−) third, (+,−) fourth.
